overloads.semanticRole: The TEXT TO DOCUMENT command lets you write the text directly to a disk file.

constraints: In fileName, you can pass just a file name (placed next to the structure file), a pathname relative to the structure file, or an absolute pathname.
By default, documents generated by this command have no extension; you must include one in fileName if desired.
If the target file already exists, its prior contents are erased, unless it is already open elsewhere, in which case an error is generated.
charSet accepts either a standard character-set name (e.g. 'ISO-8859-1', 'UTF-8') or its MIBEnum ID (as a Longint).
